tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial documents
tickets.text:
Use this checklist to coordinate divorce document requests for Mira Quillwhistle:

- Confirm the client's attorney or mediator contact information and communication permissions.
- Identify required financial statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance policies, estate documents, and debt records.
- Check that requested documents cover the relevant lookback period without using fixed calendar deadlines in the template.
- Separate joint, individual, business, retirement, and trust-related documents.
- Verify whether any restricted stock, options, deferred compensation, or pension benefits need special documentation.
- Track missing items and responsible party for each document.
- Confirm secure delivery method before transmitting any sensitive materials.
- Save copies and notes to the appropriate client file location.

Mira Quillwhistle asked for Dana Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Legal's requested account statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance pages, mortgage records, and equity compensation reports to be assembled because several items were not yet in the secure folder. Mira permitted Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate financial document delivery with Dana's office.
tickets.evidence: Mira asked for Dana’s requested account statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance pages, mortgage records, and equity compensation reports to be assembled because several items were not yet in the secure folder; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-12-06.
